class.description: SDFGrid2DResourceInspector (`Section 3.2`) Concrete Inspector Plugin mounting an `SDFGrid2DControl` (`SDFGrid2DCanvas` + `HeatmapGrid` companion view, Marching Squares iso-contour scrubber, interactive CSG brushes, and Chladni standing-wave evaluator) whenever an `SDFGrid2DResource` is inspected in the Godot Editor. Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
